Agenda Center

View current agendas and minutes for all boards and commissions.

  • Due to the coordination process, City Council Meeting agendas are typically posted the Thursday prior to each meeting and City Council Work Session agendas are typically posted the Friday prior to each session.
  • All other agendas are posted as they become available, which can vary for each board and commission.
  • If you would like to sign up for agenda alerts, visit the Notify Me page.
  • To access City Council minutes prior to 2013, visit the Archive Center.
